data_tooling.name: build-your-own-x
data_tooling.summary: Build-Your-Own-X 是一个精心编排的教程集合，通过从零开始复现各种技术来教授编程，帮助开发者通过动手实践理解系统内部原理。其核心方法是将复杂系统分解为可学习的组件，展示基础概念如何组合成复杂工具的技术思路。你可以用它构建从数据库到游戏的各种项目，在探索常用工具底层原理的同时获得实用技能——这种“边做边学”的方式非常适合想要通过主动创造来深化编程理解的开发者，为技术成长提供了一条清晰的实践路径。
data_tooling.summary_en: Build-Your-Own-X is a curated collection of tutorials that teaches programming by recreating technologies from scratch, helping developers understand system internals through hands-on implementation. Its technical insight lies in breaking down complex systems into learnable components, demonstrating how foundational concepts combine to create sophisticated tools. You can use it to build anything from databases to games, gaining practical skills while exploring how your favorite tools work under the hood—perfect for deepening your programming knowledge through active creation.

ui_devex.name: uBlock
ui_devex.summary: uBlock Origin 是一款轻量级浏览器扩展，用于拦截广告、追踪器和恶意域名，从而提升浏览速度和隐私保护。与许多同类工具不同，它通过优化代码和网络请求处理，高效利用多个过滤列表，占用极少的CPU和内存资源。你可以在Chromium或Firefox上安装，自定义过滤列表，甚至使用高级模式按站点拦截脚本和框架，实现精细控制。
ui_devex.summary_en: uBlock Origin is a lightweight browser extension that blocks ads, trackers, and malicious domains, improving browsing speed and privacy. Unlike many blockers, it uses multiple filter lists efficiently with minimal CPU and memory overhead, thanks to its optimized code and network request handling. You can install it on Chromium or Firefox, customize filter lists, or even use its advanced mode to block scripts and frames per-site for granular control.

ui_devex.name: warp
ui_devex.summary: Warp 是基于终端的智能开发环境，用 Rust 构建高性能终端模拟器，集成 AI 能力，支持自然语言生成命令与智能自动补全。它能理解上下文，实现命令搜索、错误调试和工作流自动化，并集成 Git 提供智能建议。作为传统终端替代品，Warp 将被动工具转变为主动助手，适合高效命令行操作。采用 AGPL-3.0 开源许可，鼓励社区定制。典型用途包括快速编写复杂命令、调试脚本错误及自动化重复任务。
ui_devex.summary_en: Warp is a modern, agentic development environment built from the terminal, designed to boost developer productivity. It combines a Rust-based terminal emulator with AI-powered features like natural language command generation and intelligent autocomplete. Unlike traditional terminals, Warp understands context, enabling users to search commands, debug errors, and automate workflows seamlessly. Developers can use it as a daily terminal replacement, integrate with Git, and leverage its smart suggestions to speed up coding tasks. Its open-source AGPL-3.0 license encourages community contributions and customization.

ui_devex.name: daily_stock_analysis
ui_devex.summary: 这是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的A股、港股、美股智能分析系统。它通过整合多数据源行情、实时新闻和LLM决策仪表盘，提供市场洞察与交易建议。其核心优势在于零成本定时运行，利用免费API实现全自动化分析，适合个人量化交易爱好者进行实验。你可以部署该系统，每日自动获取股票分析报告，并通过多渠道推送通知，无需手动操作。
ui_devex.summary_en: This open-source project is an LLM-powered stock analysis system for A/H/US markets. It integrates multi-source market data, real-time news, and an LLM decision dashboard to generate actionable insights. Its key strength is zero-cost scheduled execution using free APIs, making it accessible for personal quantitative trading experiments. You can deploy it to automate daily stock analysis and receive push notifications via multiple channels.

ui_devex.name: invidious
ui_devex.summary: Invidious 是一个开源的 YouTube 轻量级替代前端，旨在保护用户隐私，去除广告、追踪和数据收集。它用 Crystal 语言构建，性能高效，提供简洁可定制的界面，支持订阅管理、播放列表和纯音频模式。技术核心在于代理 YouTube 内容，无需 JavaScript，降低浏览器负担并提升安全性。你可以自建实例或使用公共实例匿名观看视频，集成 RSS 订阅，或通过尊重隐私的 API 访问 YouTube 内容。适合注重隐私的用户、教育机构或开发者，用于构建无追踪的视频服务或研究替代前端设计。
ui_devex.summary_en: Invidious is an open-source, lightweight alternative front-end to YouTube that prioritizes user privacy by eliminating ads, tracking, and data collection. Built with Crystal for performance, it offers a clean, customizable interface with features like subscription management, playlists, and audio-only mode. Technically, it proxies YouTube content without requiring JavaScript, reducing browser load and enhancing security. You can self-host it on your server or use public instances to watch videos anonymously, integrate with RSS feeds, or access YouTube content via a privacy-respecting API.

ui_devex.name: jcode
ui_devex.summary: jcode 是一个基于终端的编码代理工具，让你直接在命令行中利用 AI 进行代码生成和编辑。它用 Rust 编写，通过 MCP（模型上下文协议）连接 Claude、OpenAI 等大语言模型，实现无需离开终端的交互式编码工作流。其核心优势在于速度快、资源占用低，特别适合偏爱键盘操作的开发者。你可以用自然语言指令生成样板代码、重构或调试。通过集成自定义 MCP 工具，还能扩展其功能以处理更专业的任务。
ui_devex.summary_en: jcode is a terminal-based coding agent harness that brings AI-powered code generation and editing directly into your CLI. Built in Rust, it leverages MCP (Model Context Protocol) to connect with LLMs like Claude and OpenAI, enabling interactive code workflows without leaving the terminal. Its key strength is speed and low resource usage, making it ideal for developers who prefer keyboard-driven environments. You can use jcode to generate boilerplate, refactor code, or debug—all through natural language commands. Extend it by integrating custom MCP tools for specialized tasks.

security_safety.name: uBlock
security_safety.summary: uBlock Origin 是一款轻量级浏览器扩展，用于拦截广告、追踪器和恶意域名，从而提升浏览速度和隐私保护。与许多同类工具不同，它通过优化代码和网络请求处理，高效利用多个过滤列表，占用极少的CPU和内存资源。你可以在Chromium或Firefox上安装，自定义过滤列表，甚至使用高级模式按站点拦截脚本和框架，实现精细控制。
security_safety.summary_en: uBlock Origin is a lightweight browser extension that blocks ads, trackers, and malicious domains, improving browsing speed and privacy. Unlike many blockers, it uses multiple filter lists efficiently with minimal CPU and memory overhead, thanks to its optimized code and network request handling. You can install it on Chromium or Firefox, customize filter lists, or even use its advanced mode to block scripts and frames per-site for granular control.

security_safety.name: maigret
security_safety.summary: Maigret 是一款开源情报（OSINT）工具，通过用户名在 3000 多个网站并行搜索，利用异步请求技术高效提取社交媒体账号、论坛发言等公开资料。用户只需在命令行输入用户名，即可快速获取结构化报告。该工具适用于安全研究人员、调查记者等，可用于身份验证、数字足迹追踪、事件响应、背景调查及社交工程测试，并支持集成到自动化工作流中。
security_safety.summary_en: Maigret is an OSINT tool that collects a dossier on a person by searching their username across 3000+ websites. It uses asynchronous requests to efficiently probe sites and extract profile information, revealing social media accounts, forum posts, and more. You can run it from the command line to investigate a target username, or integrate it into your own security or research workflows for automated identity mapping.

security_safety.name: invidious
security_safety.summary: Invidious 是一个开源的 YouTube 轻量级替代前端，旨在保护用户隐私，去除广告、追踪和数据收集。它用 Crystal 语言构建，性能高效，提供简洁可定制的界面，支持订阅管理、播放列表和纯音频模式。技术核心在于代理 YouTube 内容，无需 JavaScript，降低浏览器负担并提升安全性。你可以自建实例或使用公共实例匿名观看视频，集成 RSS 订阅，或通过尊重隐私的 API 访问 YouTube 内容。适合注重隐私的用户、教育机构或开发者，用于构建无追踪的视频服务或研究替代前端设计。
security_safety.summary_en: Invidious is an open-source, lightweight alternative front-end to YouTube that prioritizes user privacy by eliminating ads, tracking, and data collection. Built with Crystal for performance, it offers a clean, customizable interface with features like subscription management, playlists, and audio-only mode. Technically, it proxies YouTube content without requiring JavaScript, reducing browser load and enhancing security. You can self-host it on your server or use public instances to watch videos anonymously, integrate with RSS feeds, or access YouTube content via a privacy-respecting API.

agents_workflows.name: warp
agents_workflows.summary: Warp 是基于终端的智能开发环境，用 Rust 构建高性能终端模拟器，集成 AI 能力，支持自然语言生成命令与智能自动补全。它能理解上下文，实现命令搜索、错误调试和工作流自动化，并集成 Git 提供智能建议。作为传统终端替代品，Warp 将被动工具转变为主动助手，适合高效命令行操作。采用 AGPL-3.0 开源许可，鼓励社区定制。典型用途包括快速编写复杂命令、调试脚本错误及自动化重复任务。
agents_workflows.summary_en: Warp is a modern, agentic development environment built from the terminal, designed to boost developer productivity. It combines a Rust-based terminal emulator with AI-powered features like natural language command generation and intelligent autocomplete. Unlike traditional terminals, Warp understands context, enabling users to search commands, debug errors, and automate workflows seamlessly. Developers can use it as a daily terminal replacement, integrate with Git, and leverage its smart suggestions to speed up coding tasks. Its open-source AGPL-3.0 license encourages community contributions and customization.

agents_workflows.name: daily_stock_analysis
agents_workflows.summary: 这是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的A股、港股、美股智能分析系统。它通过整合多数据源行情、实时新闻和LLM决策仪表盘，提供市场洞察与交易建议。其核心优势在于零成本定时运行，利用免费API实现全自动化分析，适合个人量化交易爱好者进行实验。你可以部署该系统，每日自动获取股票分析报告，并通过多渠道推送通知，无需手动操作。
agents_workflows.summary_en: This open-source project is an LLM-powered stock analysis system for A/H/US markets. It integrates multi-source market data, real-time news, and an LLM decision dashboard to generate actionable insights. Its key strength is zero-cost scheduled execution using free APIs, making it accessible for personal quantitative trading experiments. You can deploy it to automate daily stock analysis and receive push notifications via multiple channels.

deployment_serving.summary: 这是一个基于大语言模型（LLM）的A股、港股、美股智能分析系统。它通过整合多数据源行情、实时新闻和LLM决策仪表盘，提供市场洞察与交易建议。其核心优势在于零成本定时运行，利用免费API实现全自动化分析，适合个人量化交易爱好者进行实验。你可以部署该系统，每日自动获取股票分析报告，并通过多渠道推送通知，无需手动操作。
deployment_serving.summary_en: This open-source project is an LLM-powered stock analysis system for A/H/US markets. It integrates multi-source market data, real-time news, and an LLM decision dashboard to generate actionable insights. Its key strength is zero-cost scheduled execution using free APIs, making it accessible for personal quantitative trading experiments. You can deploy it to automate daily stock analysis and receive push notifications via multiple channels.

deployment_serving.name: invidious
deployment_serving.summary: Invidious 是一个开源的 YouTube 轻量级替代前端，旨在保护用户隐私，去除广告、追踪和数据收集。它用 Crystal 语言构建，性能高效，提供简洁可定制的界面，支持订阅管理、播放列表和纯音频模式。技术核心在于代理 YouTube 内容，无需 JavaScript，降低浏览器负担并提升安全性。你可以自建实例或使用公共实例匿名观看视频，集成 RSS 订阅，或通过尊重隐私的 API 访问 YouTube 内容。适合注重隐私的用户、教育机构或开发者，用于构建无追踪的视频服务或研究替代前端设计。
deployment_serving.summary_en: Invidious is an open-source, lightweight alternative front-end to YouTube that prioritizes user privacy by eliminating ads, tracking, and data collection. Built with Crystal for performance, it offers a clean, customizable interface with features like subscription management, playlists, and audio-only mode. Technically, it proxies YouTube content without requiring JavaScript, reducing browser load and enhancing security. You can self-host it on your server or use public instances to watch videos anonymously, integrate with RSS feeds, or access YouTube content via a privacy-respecting API.

framework_core.name: maigret
framework_core.summary: Maigret 是一款开源情报（OSINT）工具，通过用户名在 3000 多个网站并行搜索，利用异步请求技术高效提取社交媒体账号、论坛发言等公开资料。用户只需在命令行输入用户名，即可快速获取结构化报告。该工具适用于安全研究人员、调查记者等，可用于身份验证、数字足迹追踪、事件响应、背景调查及社交工程测试，并支持集成到自动化工作流中。
framework_core.summary_en: Maigret is an OSINT tool that collects a dossier on a person by searching their username across 3000+ websites. It uses asynchronous requests to efficiently probe sites and extract profile information, revealing social media accounts, forum posts, and more. You can run it from the command line to investigate a target username, or integrate it into your own security or research workflows for automated identity mapping.
